name: extask
description: ExTask - an open task-bidding marketplace (React, Express, Supabase)

scripts.setup: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install && node scripts/setup-env.js
scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names server,client --prefix-colors yellow,cyan "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.lint: npm --prefix server run lint && npm --prefix client run lint
